discovery.help:
az-axi group list
az-axi group show --name <group> --subscription <id>
Lists live ARM resource groups in selected subscriptions (flags, environment, profile, else all accessible). Subscription names resolve to IDs. Management-group scope is unsupported.
--limit defaults to 50; --full shows complete metadata and all fetched rows; --fields selects metadata fields. Lists follow up to 100 pages per subscription and disclose incomplete counts.
Examples: az-axi group list; az-axi group list -s <subscription> --full
Requires --name / -n and exactly one selected subscription (ID or unambiguous name).
Default: name, id, location, state; --full returns the complete ARM resource group.
Examples: az-axi group show -n <group> -s <subscription>; az-axi group show -n <group> --full
